user.title: Set up Lighting Manager
user.description: Lighting Manager manages your whole house's lighting from one panel. Nothing is auto-adopted - the first-run review lets you choose what to bring in.

storage_corrupt.title: Lighting Manager storage could not be loaded
storage_corrupt.description: Lighting Manager's own metadata store failed to load or migrate ({detail}). Managed-light identity, adoption state, and countdown state may be affected until this is resolved.

provider_failure.title: Lighting Manager scheduler provider unavailable
provider_failure.description: The {provider} integration Lighting Manager was using for scheduling is no longer available. Scheduling features are disabled until it's reinstalled or reconfigured; countdown timers are unaffected since they're native to Lighting Manager.

init.title: Lighting Manager options
init.description: Lighting Manager adds two ready-made pages to the sidebar: Lights (everything by room) and Schedules (one schedule list per room). Switch them off here if you would rather build your own dashboards; the cards stay available.

data.show_sidebar_pages: Show the Lights and Schedules pages in the sidebar
